title: The Counter Sale customer stays on COD whatever the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the organization's built-in Counter Sale customer is customer A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's customer page.
  2. On the Credit Terms page, click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Type customer A's name in "Search customers".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Credit term" reads COD, although the default is Net 30.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The window opens (or Move Customers is greyed if no other customer is on COD).

Step 4:

  • "No customers match your search." — the Counter Sale customer is never listed, so it can never be moved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-R2: “No existing customer, vendor or invoice changes term, credit limit or due date at release. The Counter Sale customer stays on COD permanently.”
  • Terminology: “Counter Sale customer → The organization's built-in walk-in customer that over-the-counter sales are invoiced to; there is exactly one per organization, created with the organization. It always stays on COD and is never counted, listed or moved on the Credit Terms page.”
  • S5-R15: “Every customer created in the app (from the Customers page, New Work Order and New Part Sale) is created in this New Customer window, so this story covers all of them. Imports and the Public API are the only other ways to create a customer (Story 10: Imports and Public API); the Counter Sale customer is created with the organization and always on COD.”
